title: “Educating Others Through Educating Ourselves” SCA Pesah message from Mrs. Yaffa Setton

chapters.about: Sefer Shemot and the commandment to tell children about Yitziat Mitzrayim

chapters.title: The importance of asking questions

chapters.title: Modeling learning for children

summary: Mrs. Setton discusses the obligation to tell the story of Yitziat Mitzrayim at the seder. She explains why asking questions is central to the learning process and how modeling this behavior helps children connect to the relevance of the Exodus.
questions: Why do we start the seder with questions instead of the story?
Why must a person ask questions even when alone at the seder?
How does asking questions make the seder experience more personal?
How does our own learning influence our children?
